name: River Stablecoin
oneLiner: satUSD is River's omni-CDP stablecoin overcollateralized by BTC, ETH, BNB, and LSTs; collateral stays source-chain and satUSD is minted via LayerZero OFT.
collateral: BTC, ETH, BNB, and liquid staking tokens; no centralized stablecoin collateral accepted
pegMechanism: Omni-CDP overcollateralized by BTC, ETH, BNB, or LSTs; collateral stays on its source chain and satUSD is minted natively on the destination chain via LayerZero OFT messaging; peg maintained through stability pools, on-chain liquidations, and $1-of-collateral redemption arbitrage

oracleRisk.summary: Thirty-one callable collateral branches across 11 chains use branch-local single-provider or all-components-required aggregate wrappers. Each wrapper fails closed on non-positive or older-than-configured input and has no cache or automatic provider failover; liquidations are immediate, Stability Pool first, then redistribution.

branchApplicability.reviewer: Codex Safety Score V9 ORCL curation
branchApplicability.rationale: The 11 official deployment registries and fixed-block contract reads enumerate exactly 31 callable TroveManagers. Twenty-eight carried positive or defaulted debt. X Layer WETH, BOB WBTC, and BOB FBTC had zero debt but remained unpaused, unsunset, callable, and configured with nonzero caps, so they remain live branches rather than exclusions.

branches.label: ethereum WETH Trove branch
branches.summary: The callable WETH branch uses one Chainlink wrapper path with a contract-enforced 3900-second maximum age.
branches.fallbackBehavior: The branch wrapper reverts on a non-positive or older-than-3900-second source. There is no cached-price or alternate-provider fallback; an admin-configurable source or threshold is not automatic failover.

collateralParameters.note: TroveManager 0xb97E6219B0836E21ae671358e746f03dcdbCb6D8; PriceFeed 0x44AfcF491d9BcA179F9F99d7b11EC5519895f317; debt 84057591437969129521091 raw 18-decimal satUSD; cap 1000000 satUSD; sunsetting=false and paused=false.

branches.liquidationMechanism: Any caller can execute an immediate fixed-path liquidation below MCR; there is no auction or keeper allowlist. The chain-local Stability Pool burns satUSD against seized collateral first and any unoffset debt/collateral is redistributed across surviving troves; Recovery Mode expands eligibility up to TCR or 150% subject to pool coverage.
branches.backstop: Chain-local depositor-funded Stability Pool offsets liquidations first; flash-loan execution can supply atomic liquidity but is not committed insurance. Any remainder is redistributed to active troves.
branches.shutdownOrBadDebtBehavior: Owner sunset sets the branch cap to zero, blocks new debt, and leaves repayment, redemption, and liquidation live. Unoffset debt and collateral are redistributed to surviving troves; the final trove cannot be liquidated and must repay or be redeemed.

reserves.name: BTC, ETH, BNB, and liquid-staking-token CDP collateral basket

reserveReview.rationale: River states that satUSD is minted against BTC, ETH, BNB, and liquid staking tokens through its omni-CDP system. The issuer does not publish a current collateral allocation or a chain-wide pool inventory, so the previously stored asset-class weights are not supportable and are replaced with the documented aggregate basket.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: River current product and FAQ collateral disclosures
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: River does not publish current weights among BTC, ETH, BNB, and liquid staking tokens or a complete cross-chain collateral inventory.

mintAuthority.summary: satUSD's Ethereum and Base DebtTokenWithLz proxies mint for chain-specific SatoshiXApp and enabled TroveManager contracts, plus owner-appointed wards. Both UUPS proxies share one EOA owner that can upgrade mint logic or appoint unrestricted wards, but the ward and TroveManager sets cannot be exhaustively enumerated from contract state or events.

upgradeability.controlRef: satUSD UUPS owner and ward administrator

controls.label: satUSD Ethereum SatoshiXApp mint path
controls.capDescription: The verified debt token permits this SatoshiXApp to mint CDP debt and fixed gas compensation; the intended economic bound is the source-chain overcollateralized position and liquidation logic.
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25530324, satoshiXApp() on proxy 0x195885... returned this contract. Verified DebtTokenWithLz source permits satoshiXApp to call mint(), mintWithGasCompensation(), and enableTroveManager().

controls.label: satUSD Base SatoshiXApp mint path
controls.capDescription: The verified debt token permits this SatoshiXApp to mint CDP debt and fixed gas compensation; the intended economic bound is the source-chain overcollateralized position and liquidation logic.
controls.evidence: At Base block 48618018, satoshiXApp() on proxy 0x70654... returned this contract. The Base proxy uses the same verified DebtTokenWithLz mint checks as Ethereum.

controls.label: satUSD UUPS owner and ward administrator
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25530324 and Base block 48618018, owner() on both satUSD UUPS proxies returned this address and eth_getCode returned empty bytecode. Verified implementation source gates _authorizeUpgrade(), rely(), and deny() with onlyOwner; a relied ward may call mint() without a numeric token-contract cap.

review.evidence: RPC reads establish both current SatoshiXApp addresses, both UUPS implementations, and the shared owner. Verified DebtTokenWithLz source shows three mint-authorized classes: satoshiXApp, troveManager mapping entries, and owner-managed wards. Because rely(), deny(), and enableTroveManager() emit no membership events and neither mapping is enumerable, exact current ward and TroveManager membership cannot be reconstructed safely from the contract interface alone.
